summary: Iteration 11 targeted retest: verified nested <button> hydration warning is resolved on /deposit and UPI card interactions still work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Deposit.jsx UPI card correctly uses <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onClick onKeyDown> — accessible replacement for outer <button>.
Inner Copy UPI button and View QR anchor both call e.stopPropagation() — event bubbling to outer card selection is prevented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deposit page nested-button hydration warning fixed. Verified: (1) console has ZERO nested-button / hydration / descendant warnings on /deposit navigation & interactions, (2) clicking upi-option-<id> selects card (blue border + 'selected' chip), (3) Copy UPI inner button copies value ('Copied' toast) and does NOT deselect card (stopPropagation OK), (4) Space/Enter key on focused card triggers selection without errors, (5) QR link absent for tested UPI but code path has stopPropagation. Only 1 UPI configured so Enter-on-2nd-card path not exercised, but Space on focused card was tested without regression. Backend testing skipped per request.
rca of the issue: Root cause of prior hydration warning: outer UPI card was a <button> containing inner <button> (Copy UPI) and <a> (View QR). React/HTML disallows interactive descendants inside a <button>. Fix: outer element changed to <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onClick onKeyDown> preserving semantics + accessibility, while inner interactive elements retain e.stopPropagation() so bubbling does not double-fire card select. Verified in Iter 11 — no warnings emitted, all behaviors preserved.
